requirements.title: Encrypted DNS options include an ADN
requirements.statement: Encrypted DNS options MUST always include an ADN.

requirements.title: Router or forwarder single LAN-facing address
requirements.statement: A router embedding a recursive server or a forwarder MUST include one IP address pointing to one of its LAN-facing interfaces.

requirements.title: Preference-ordered multiple IP addresses
requirements.statement: If multiple IP addresses are returned in an Encrypted DNS option, they MUST be returned ordered by preference.

requirements.title: Encode service parameters with the RFC9460 wire format
requirements.statement: These parameters MUST be encoded following the same rules for encoding SvcParams using the wire format specified in Section 2.2 of [RFC9460].

requirements.title: Prefer ADN-only provisioning mode
requirements.statement: ADN-only provisioning mode SHOULD be used.
notes: Trimmed to the core normative obligation; rationale removed.

requirements.title: ADN presence and encoding
requirements.statement: The ADN MUST be present and encoded as specified in Section 10 of RFC 8415.

requirements.title: Service parameter encoding rules
requirements.statement: The service parameters MUST be encoded according to Section 2.2 of RFC 9460.

requirements.title: At least one valid IP address
requirements.statement: The Encrypted DNS option MUST include at least one valid IP address.

requirements.title: No hint parameters in service parameters
requirements.statement: The service parameters MUST exclude "ipv4hint" and "ipv6hint" parameters.

requirements.title: Discard invalid Encrypted DNS option
requirements.statement: If any validation check fails, the receiver MUST discard the received Encrypted DNS option.

requirements.title: Service priority when implicit ordering is absent
requirements.statement: When multiple encrypted DNS instances are used and implicit ordering is not relied on, the DNR information SHOULD include a service priority.

requirements.title: Mandatory ADN parameter
requirements.statement: The ADN parameter MUST be present in the DNR information.

requirements.title: Resolver IP address list
requirements.statement: The DNR information SHOULD include IP addresses used to locate the encrypted DNS resolver.

requirements.title: Service parameter set
requirements.statement: The DNR information SHOULD include a set of service parameters.

requirements.title: Follow RFC8106 conflict rules for RA and DHCP discovery
requirements.statement: If encrypted DNS resolvers are discovered by a host using both RA and DHCP, the rules discussed in Section 5.3.1 of [RFC8106] MUST be followed.

requirements.title: Prefer encrypted DNS when both resolver types are learned
requirements.statement: If a client learns both Do53 and encrypted DNS resolvers from the same network, and there is no explicit configuration to the contrary, the client SHOULD use the encrypted DNS resolvers for that network.

requirements.title: Allow fallback to Do53 when encrypted DNS connection fails
requirements.statement: If the client cannot establish an authenticated and encrypted connection with the encrypted DNS resolver, it MAY fall back to using the Do53 resolver.

requirements.title: Establish sessions according to discovered resolver priority
requirements.statement: If the local DNS client supports one of the discovered encrypted DNS protocols identified by ALPN protocol identifiers or another service parameter that indicates another protocol disambiguation mechanism, the DNS client MUST establish an encrypted DNS session following the service priority of the discovered encrypted resolvers.

requirements.title: Validate resolver certificates and ADN using PKIX and RFC6125
requirements.statement: The DNS client MUST verify the connection using PKIX validation of the DNS resolver certificate and compare the ADN conveyed in the Encrypted DNS options to the certificate using RFC6125 validation techniques.

requirements.title: Use default trust anchors unless explicit trust anchors are configured
requirements.statement: The DNS client MUST use the default system or application PKI trust anchors unless configured otherwise to use explicit trust anchors.

requirements.title: Encode the OPTION_V6_DNR option format
requirements.statement: The OPTION_V6_DNR option format MUST be encoded with OPTION_V6_DNR, Option-length, Service Priority, ADN Length, authentication-domain-name, Addr Length, ipv6-address(es), and Service Parameters (SvcParams) in that order.

requirements.title: Set the OPTION_V6_DNR option code
requirements.statement: The OPTION_V6_DNR option code MUST be 144.

requirements.title: Set Option-length to the enclosed data size
requirements.statement: The Option-length field MUST be the length of the enclosed data in octets.

requirements.title: Set Option-length when only ADN is present
requirements.statement: When only an ADN is included in the option, the option length MUST be the ADN Length plus 4.

requirements.title: Interpret Service Priority as a 16-bit unsigned integer
requirements.statement: The Service Priority field MUST be interpreted as a 16-bit unsigned integer following the rules specified in Section 2.4.1 of [RFC9460].

requirements.title: Define ADN Length field
requirements.statement: The ADN Length field MUST be the length of the authentication-domain-name field in octets.

requirements.title: Define authentication-domain-name field
requirements.statement: The authentication-domain-name field MUST be a Fully Qualified Domain Name (FQDN) of the encrypted DNS resolver.

requirements.title: Format authentication-domain-name field
requirements.statement: The authentication-domain-name field MUST be formatted as specified in Section 10 of [RFC8415].

requirements.title: Define Addr Length field
requirements.statement: The Addr Length field MUST be the length of enclosed IPv6 addresses in octets.

requirements.title: Constrain Addr Length multiple
requirements.statement: When present, the Addr Length field MUST be a multiple of 16.

requirements.title: IPv6 address semantics
requirements.statement: The `ipv6-address(es)` field MUST indicate one or more IPv6 addresses to reach the encrypted DNS resolver.

requirements.title: IPv6 address field layout
requirements.statement: The `ipv6-address` field MUST use the variable-length layout shown in Figure 3.

requirements.title: SvcParams encoding
requirements.statement: The Service Parameters (SvcParams) field MUST be a variable-length set of service parameters encoded following the rules in Section 2.2 of RFC9460.

requirements.title: Prefer alpn SvcParam
requirements.statement: The SvcParams field SHOULD include the "alpn" SvcParam.
notes: Trimmed to the smallest independently testable wording.

requirements.title: Exclude superseded SvcParams
requirements.statement: The service parameters MUST omit "ipv4hint" and "ipv6hint" SvcParams.
notes: Trimmed the explanatory clause while preserving the exclusion rule.

requirements.title: Use default port numbers when port service parameter is omitted
requirements.statement: If no port service parameter is included, the default port numbers SHOULD be 853 for DoT, 443 for DoH, and 853 for DoQ.

upstream_refs: RFC 9463 section 4.1 source units RFC9463-S4P1-B18-P18-S1 and RFC9463-S4P1-B18-P18-S2

notes: Merged with RFC9463-S4P1-B18-P18-S2 because it supplies the concrete default values for the omission rule.

requirements.title: Compute field length
requirements.statement: The field length MUST equal ('Option-length' - 6 - 'ADN Length' - 'Addr Length').

requirements.title: Omit fields in ADN-only mode
requirements.statement: When ADN-only mode is used, the `Addr Length`, `ipv6-address(es)`, and `Service Parameters (SvcParams)` fields MUST be absent.

requirements.title: Request OPTION_V6_DNR
requirements.statement: The DHCPv6 client MUST include OPTION_V6_DNR in an Option Request Option (ORO).
notes: Trimmed to the single testable invariant while preserving traceability to the source unit.

requirements.title: Accept multiple OPTION_V6_DNR instances
requirements.statement: The DHCPv6 client MUST be prepared to receive multiple instances of the OPTION_V6_DNR option.
notes: Split out as a separately testable acceptance obligation.

requirements.title: Treat each resolver separately
requirements.statement: Each OPTION_V6_DNR option MUST be treated as a separate encrypted DNS resolver.
notes: Split out as a separately testable per-instance handling obligation.

requirements.title: Process instances by service priority
requirements.statement: The DHCPv6 client MUST process OPTION_V6_DNR instances in service-priority order, where a smaller value indicates higher preference.
notes: Trimmed to the ordering rule without changing the testable meaning.

requirements.title: Silently discard invalid OPTION_V6_DNR values
requirements.statement: The DHCPv6 client MUST silently discard any OPTION_V6_DNR that fails Section 3.1.8 validation.
notes: Trimmed while preserving the validation reference needed for implementation and testing.

requirements.title: Silently discard multicast and loopback addresses
requirements.statement: The DHCPv6 client MUST silently discard multicast and host loopback addresses in OPTION_V6_DNR.
notes: Trimmed to the address-class rule while preserving the source unit trace.

requirements.title: Define OPTION_V4_DNR option format
requirements.statement: An OPTION_V4_DNR option MUST have a Length field followed by DNR Instance Data.

requirements.title: Define OPTION_V4_DNR code
requirements.statement: The OPTION_V4_DNR option code MUST be 162.
notes: Trimmed to the option code.

requirements.title: Length field semantics
requirements.statement: The Length field MUST indicate the length of the enclosed data in octets.

requirements.title: Define DNR Instance Data format
requirements.statement: A DNR Instance Data block MUST encode the fields DNR Instance Data Length, Service Priority, ADN Length, authentication-domain-name, Addr Length, IPv4 Address(es), and Service Parameters in the order shown.

requirements.title: Repeat DNR Instance Data for multiple resolvers
requirements.statement: When several encrypted DNS resolvers are to be included, the DNR Instance Data field MUST be repeated.

requirements.title: DNR Instance Data Length field semantics
requirements.statement: The DNR Instance Data Length field MUST indicate the length of all following data in octets.

requirements.title: Set DNR Instance Data Length for ADN-only instances
requirements.statement: When only an ADN is provided for a DNR instance, the DNR Instance Data Length field MUST be set to ADN Length + 3.
notes: Named the field explicitly.

requirements.title: Interpret Service Priority per RFC9460
requirements.statement: The Service Priority field MUST be interpreted following the rules specified in Section 2.4.1 of [RFC9460].
notes: Named the field explicitly.

requirements.title: Define ADN Length semantics
requirements.statement: The ADN Length field MUST be the length of the authentication-domain-name field in octets.

requirements.title: Define authentication-domain-name contents
requirements.statement: The authentication-domain-name field MUST contain the ADN of the encrypted DNS resolver.

requirements.title: Format authentication-domain-name per RFC8415
requirements.statement: The authentication-domain-name field MUST be formatted as specified in Section 10 of [RFC8415].

requirements.title: Define Addr Length semantics
requirements.statement: The Addr Length field MUST be the length of included IPv4 addresses in octets.

requirements.title: Require Addr Length to be a multiple of 4
requirements.statement: When present, the Addr Length field MUST be a multiple of 4.

requirements.title: Define IPv4 Address(es) contents
requirements.statement: The IPv4 Address(es) field MUST indicate one or more IPv4 addresses to reach the encrypted DNS resolver.

requirements.title: Allow private and public IPv4 addresses
requirements.statement: The IPv4 Address(es) field MAY include both private and public IPv4 addresses.

requirements.title: Encode Service Parameters per RFC9460
requirements.statement: The SvcParams field MUST be encoded following the rules in Section 2.2 of [RFC9460].
notes: Wording trimmed to the field-level invariant.

requirements.title: Include ALPN SvcParam
requirements.statement: The SvcParams field SHOULD include at least the "alpn" SvcParam.
notes: Wording trimmed to the standalone recommendation.

requirements.title: Exclude ipv4hint SvcParam
requirements.statement: The service parameters MUST NOT include "ipv4hint".
notes: One of two split prohibitions.

requirements.title: Exclude ipv6hint SvcParam
requirements.statement: The service parameters MUST NOT include "ipv6hint".
notes: One of two split prohibitions.

requirements.title: Use Default Ports When No Port Service Parameter Is Present
requirements.statement: Default port numbers SHOULD be used if no port service parameter is included.
notes: Wording trimmed to the conditional recommendation.

requirements.title: Compute Field Length From Component Lengths
requirements.statement: The length of this field MUST equal ('DNR Instance Data Length' - 4 - 'ADN Length' - 'Addr Length').
notes: Wording tightened to an equality requirement.

requirements.title: Omit Addr Length in ADN-Only Mode
requirements.statement: The "Addr Length" field MUST NOT be present in ADN-only mode.
notes: One of three split field-absence requirements.

requirements.title: Omit IPv4 Address Fields in ADN-Only Mode
requirements.statement: The "IPv4 Address(es)" field MUST NOT be present in ADN-only mode.
notes: One of three split field-absence requirements.

requirements.title: Omit Service Parameters in ADN-Only Mode
requirements.statement: The "Service Parameters (SvcParams)" field MUST NOT be present in ADN-only mode.
notes: One of three split field-absence requirements.

requirements.title: Use RFC3396 for Oversized OPTION_V4_DNR
requirements.statement: The mechanism specified in [RFC3396] MUST be used if OPTION_V4_DNR exceeds 255 octets.
notes: Wording trimmed to the overflow condition.

requirements.title: Request OPTION_V4_DNR to Discover Encrypted DNS Resolver
requirements.statement: The DHCPv4 client MUST request an encrypted DNS resolver by including OPTION_V4_DNR in the Parameter Request List.
notes: Trimmed the phrasing to the smallest testable invariant without changing behavior.

requirements.title: Receive Multiple DNR Instance Data Entries
requirements.statement: The DHCPv4 client MUST be prepared to receive multiple "DNR Instance Data" entries in OPTION_V4_DNR.
notes: Separated from the per-entry interpretation obligation for independent testing.

requirements.title: Treat Each DNR Instance Data Entry Separately
requirements.statement: Each "DNR Instance Data" entry MUST be treated as a separate encrypted DNS resolver.
notes: Keeps the per-entry handling requirement distinct from reception support.

requirements.title: Process Instances by Service Priority
requirements.statement: These instances MUST be processed by service priority, with smaller values indicating higher preference.
notes: Trimmed the explanatory parenthetical while preserving the ordering rule.

requirements.title: Discard Invalid OPTION_V4_DNR Entries
requirements.statement: The DHCPv4 client MUST silently discard any OPTION_V4_DNR that fails the validation steps in Section 3.1.8.
notes: Trimmed the wording to the implementation-relevant validation condition.

requirements.title: Discard Host Loopback Addresses
requirements.statement: The DHCPv4 client MUST silently discard host loopback addresses conveyed in OPTION_V4_DNR.
notes: Isolated as its own testable discard rule.

requirements.title: Discard Multicast Addresses
requirements.statement: The DHCPv4 client MUST silently discard multicast addresses conveyed in OPTION_V4_DNR.
notes: Isolated as its own testable discard rule.

requirements.title: Encrypted DNS option field order
requirements.statement: The Encrypted DNS option MUST use the field order Type, Length, Service Priority, Lifetime, ADN Length, authentication-domain-name, Addr Length, ipv6-address(es), SvcParams Length, and Service Parameters.

requirements.title: Encrypted DNS option type value
requirements.statement: The Type field MUST be the IANA-assigned 8-bit identifier for the Encrypted DNS option (144).

requirements.title: Encrypted DNS option length field encoding
requirements.statement: The Length field MUST be an 8-bit unsigned integer.

requirements.title: Encrypted DNS option length units
requirements.statement: The option length, including the Type and Length fields, MUST be measured in units of 8 octets.

requirements.title: Encrypted DNS service priority field encoding
requirements.statement: The Service Priority field MUST be a 16-bit unsigned integer.

requirements.title: Field interpretation follows RFC 9460
requirements.statement: The field MUST be interpreted following the rules specified in Section 2.4.1 of RFC 9460.

requirements.title: Lifetime field type
requirements.statement: Lifetime MUST be a 32-bit unsigned integer.

requirements.title: Lifetime validity semantics
requirements.statement: Lifetime MUST represent the maximum time in seconds, relative to the time the packet is received, over which the discovered ADN is valid.

requirements.title: Default Lifetime recommendation
requirements.statement: The value of Lifetime SHOULD by default be at least 3 * MaxRtrAdvInterval, where MaxRtrAdvInterval is the maximum RA interval as defined in RFC 4861.

requirements.title: Infinity encoding
requirements.statement: A value of all one bits (0xffffffff) MUST represent infinity.

requirements.title: Zero value retires ADN
requirements.statement: A value of zero MUST indicate that this ADN is no longer used.

requirements.title: ADN Length encoding
requirements.statement: The ADN Length field MUST be a 16-bit unsigned integer.

requirements.title: ADN Length meaning
requirements.statement: The ADN Length field MUST indicate the length of the authentication-domain-name field in octets.

requirements.title: authentication-domain-name contents
requirements.statement: The authentication-domain-name field MUST contain the ADN of the encrypted DNS resolver.

requirements.title: authentication-domain-name RFC 8415 formatting
requirements.statement: The authentication-domain-name field MUST be formatted as specified in Section 10 of RFC 8415.

requirements.title: Addr Length encoding
requirements.statement: The Addr Length field MUST be a 16-bit unsigned integer.

requirements.title: Addr Length meaning
requirements.statement: The Addr Length field MUST indicate the length of the enclosed IPv6 addresses in octets.

requirements.title: Addr Length multiple of 16
requirements.statement: When present, the Addr Length field MUST be a multiple of 16.

requirements.title: ipv6-address(es) contents
requirements.statement: The ipv6-address(es) field MUST contain one or more IPv6 addresses of the encrypted DNS resolver.

requirements.title: Shared Lifetime value across addresses
requirements.statement: All addresses in the option MUST share the same Lifetime value.

requirements.title: SvcParams Length field type
requirements.statement: The SvcParams Length field MUST be a 16-bit unsigned integer.

requirements.title: SvcParams Length field semantics
requirements.statement: The SvcParams Length field MUST indicate the length of the Service Parameters (SvcParams) field in octets.

requirements.title: SvcParams encoding follows RFC9460
requirements.statement: The Service Parameters (SvcParams) field MUST be encoded following the rules in Section 2.2 of RFC9460.

requirements.title: SvcParams field variable length
requirements.statement: The Service Parameters (SvcParams) field MUST be variable length.

requirements.title: Include alpn SvcParam
requirements.statement: The field SHOULD include at least the "alpn" SvcParam.

requirements.title: Exclude ipv4hint and ipv6hint SvcParams
requirements.statement: The service parameters MUST exclude "ipv4hint" or "ipv6hint" SvcParams.

requirements.title: Default port numbers when port parameter absent
requirements.statement: If no port service parameter is included, default port numbers SHOULD be used.

requirements.title: Omit fields in ADN-only mode
requirements.statement: When ADN-only mode is used, the Addr Length, ipv6-address(es), and Service Parameters (SvcParams) fields MUST be absent.

requirements.title: Pad option to 8-octet boundary
requirements.statement: The option MUST be padded with zeros so that the full enclosed data is a multiple of 8 octets.

requirements.title: Process received Encrypted DNS options
requirements.statement: The host MUST process received Encrypted DNS options using the RFC 8106 Section 5.3.1 procedure, substituting the Section 6.1 formatting requirements and Section 3.1.8 validation checks for length and field validations.

requirements.title: Receive multiple Encrypted DNS options
requirements.statement: The host MUST be prepared to receive multiple Encrypted DNS options in RAs.

requirements.title: Process instances by service priority
requirements.statement: These instances MUST be processed in service-priority order, where a smaller service priority value indicates a higher preference.

requirements.title: Discard host loopback encrypted DNS addresses
requirements.statement: The host MUST silently discard host loopback addresses conveyed in the Encrypted DNS options.

requirements.title: Discard multicast encrypted DNS addresses
requirements.statement: The host MUST silently discard multicast addresses conveyed in the Encrypted DNS options.

requirements.title: Allow OPTION_V6_DNR in the client ORO
requirements.statement: The OPTION_V6_DNR option MUST be requestable in the client ORO.

requirements.title: Assign DHCPv6 option code 144 to OPTION_V6_DNR
requirements.statement: The DHCPv6 option code for OPTION_V6_DNR MUST be 144.

requirements.title: Do not mark OPTION_V6_DNR as singleton
requirements.statement: The OPTION_V6_DNR option MUST NOT be a singleton option.

requirements.title: Assign DHCPv4 tag 162 to OPTION_V4_DNR
requirements.statement: The DHCPv4 option tag for OPTION_V4_DNR MUST be 162.

requirements.title: Set OPTION_V4_DNR data length to N
requirements.statement: The OPTION_V4_DNR option data length MUST be N.

requirements.title: Assign ND type 144 to the Encrypted DNS option
requirements.statement: The Neighbor Discovery Encrypted DNS option type MUST be 144.
